column1: # player area (0x1a0000-0x1c0000): Player class, player record, helpers. See docs/player.md

column3: reads a count then 12-byte records and adds each floor decal through 0x19f110; returns bytes consumed
resets the decal pools (0x19f018) and registers draw task 0x19f4e8 at priority 0x1c
(entries, a, b, slot) walks a zero-terminated list of 16-byte entries, reads pad edge words and the per-slot repeat timer 0x4d8a10; Inferred role, not read in full
(entries, index) clamps index to the entry count and stores it in the terminator entry
Inferred: same callers as menuList_handleInput, callees are text drawing; not read
(t, rgbaA, rgbaB) per-channel interpolation of two packed colours
debug walk of the 6095 handle nodes at 0x847268; prints and traps on a pointer outside the pool
threads the 20-byte handle nodes into the free list headed at 0x864ea8
(node) unlinks a node and its partner node, returns both to the free list, returns the object stored at node+0xc
(listHead, obj) takes a free node and links it at the head
(listHead, afterNode, obj) as handle_addNode but after a given node when one is passed

(this, pos, angle, slot, displayOnly) Creature ctor 0x109d68, vtable 0x511308, two lights, model part handles, flag |= 0x4040, +0x3c8 = slot, state = 2; registers g_players[slot].obj unless displayOnly
(name, second) strips extension and trailing digits and searches the loaded equipment-cache header; Inferred, read in part
loads eqcache.hdr, or eqcache2.hdr when more than one player, into a tagged allocation
true when the cached slots at 0x865a38 match every player's model index (+0x54) and the multi-player flag
(name, cacheSlot, outA, outB) returns the cached model for an item picture name, starting an async read on a miss
(freeAll) waits for a pending read (0x172c20) and clears cache slots; Inferred, read in part
Inferred: called by Player_draw after Creature_draw with (scale, player, drawResult) and by the inventory model view 0x1c0920; decompile failed, not read
(player, pad) feeds the hand midpoint to vslot 17; when the ability button is released or mana is gone ends the cast: state 5 -> 2 and tells the channelled spell (+0x588) to stop
(player, abilityRecord) new-style skills only: canUse, cast (vslot 2), cooldown +0x4ae, mana cost; for the prediction copy only skills with flag bit 0 run and the returned spell is destroyed at once
clears the seven class skill tables at 0x4ef530 (stride 0xa88, 48 entries of 0x38 bytes) and fills them
(slot) 20 KB of per-class inventory_giveItem / inventory_equipItem calls; called at the end of player_initNewCharacter; not read in full

(slot, model 0-11, name, 4 appearance bytes, stats or 0, difficulty, team) zeroes the record, derives class +0x50 from the model, default stats from 0x4ef400, 500 gold, then recalcStats and starting items
(slot) restarts the idle animation track for the current weapon class (+0x4a86); 12 callers
skips the prediction copy; mana += max*0.0001 scaled by passive 0x200, item modifier 0xc and two spells; then drains the pending potion amount +0xc8 at rate +0xbc
skips the prediction copy; hp += max*0.0001 scaled by passive 0x10 and item modifier 0xb; then drains the pending potion amount +0xb4 at rate +0xb8
(player, velocity, outMask) tests the move against the four view planes at 0x4f8350; only called when g_networkMode is 0
(player, mode 0-6, pad, extVelocity) stick + per-slot camera yaw (0x13e0c8) -> facing and velocity, speed scale, water test, then creature move/collide 0x1186d8; returns footstep event bits
vslot 2 (amount, attacker, flags): early-outs, block handling (states 8/0xb), mana-shield spell, then accumulates pending damage +0xc8 / flags +0x2dc and links the attacker at +0x2e4
(slot) zeroes object +0x5c..+0x6c, sums equipped items and returns the value player_recalcStats stores at object +0xe4
(player, arg) arg 0: play an animation and set state 0; arg 1: set state 1; meaning of the slot not established
vslot 20: monsters yes unless charmed/hidden; other players only in PvP mode A and on a different team (+0x4c24)
counts g_recallCountdown down; at 60 starts the blue aura on every player, at 1 stores each player's return position (+0x44) and level (+0x24) and requests the level change
(slot, item) item_getScaledField08 times class/skill reductions; summed into record +0x120
every player: effective stats +0x90.. = base +0x78.. + item modifiers 7-10, max hp +0xb0, max mana +0xc4, load limit +0x124, armour, clamps hp/mana to max
(scale, player, target, a, flags) returns at once for the prediction copy; line-of-sight test, picks main or second weapon, Player_recalcDamage, then the damage function 0x1e8230
(slot, kind) plays a character voice line; returns at once unless slot is local; also gated by cutscene, local menu and audio status 0x216388
sets +0x4b4 to 60 (90 in a net game), may hide the player, creates a LightEffect; called by player_respawn

(speed, player) advances the animation set +0x114 and converts root motion +0xbc/+0xc0 to world axes; passes no position for the machine's own real player (flag 0x200000) so its sound cues are not played; returns event bits
(player, silent) sound and spark particles between the hands when a hit is blocked
(slot, kind) sums the quantity of the nine potion types of one kind in bag 2
vslot 5 of the Projectile class with vtable 0x50e470
vslot 4 of the Projectile class with vtable 0x50e470 (thrown weapons and potions); not read in full
(range, player) picks the nearest visible creature in a 60-degree cone ahead and links it at +0x234; clears +0x4b8
(player, pad, force) swap button 0x41ba30: toggles the weapon set +0x4a7c in state 2 and equips that set's weapons; call site in Player_run excludes the prediction copy
(player, weaponClass) chooses the next attack animation variant +0x461 from the model index and a hash of the frame counter; advances g_randSeed once
draw-phase: overhead marker for each player when more than one is in the game and option 0x4f8458 is on
(player, pad) rare random fidget animation when standing still (g_randSeed), cancelled by stick movement
skips the prediction copy; counts down the timed modifiers (ids in the list at 0x537c08) on the 17 equipped items
cosmetic weapon trail/particle update for the active weapon and the second weapon; in a net game the local slot is handled by the prediction copy only
(player, target) spark particles between random bones of attacker and target; draws g_randSeed
for each local player: raw local pad (use button held + bit 0x100 pressed) and a list of blocking conditions -> hudmsg_sendRecall
(slot, pos, angle, a, b) deletes the old object, hp = half max (full in PvP), new Player object, spawn protection, forces a prediction rebase, rebuilds the alive list, resets the local camera
(slot, src) fills a record from a character stored in a different, larger layout (offsets shift by 0x10 after +0xb0, 0x5db0+ bytes); level capped at 50; called from 0x21fa2c
(mission, level) for every player whose medal byte is lower: runs the first-bronze/silver/gold script hooks and stores the level
(font, index, text, width) copies text into scratch buffer 0x4f3ec8[index] and shortens it to fit; 9 callers
(slot) zero-run-length encodes the 0x4c30-byte record into the save area; used by net_launchTransfer
(slot) removes bag items whose flag bit 39 is set, except a few named item types
(slot or -1 for all, bit, on) record +0x4c28 bit field; script built-in setPlayerFlag
builds the item picture name (item_buildPictureFilename) and calls eqcache_lookupModel
(amount, player) subtracts mana if enough, else cancels the cast and plays the no-mana voice; no direct caller found
zeroes the per-slot aura light globals 0x4d8a40/0x4d8a90/0x4d8aa0/0x4d8ab0
(slot) 0.861945 offline, 0.75 in a net game, times record +0x4c20 and global 0x4f8418, capped at 1.2
vslot 6: in state 9 passes the touched creature to the rush spell (0x2c95f4); skips the prediction copy
sets state 2 and the action frame stamp, fades the top animation track
(slot) record +0x120 = sum of player_itemWeight over the three bags
(slot, mask) finds mask in the class skill table 0x4ef538[class] and returns the level byte at record +0xef+index
(slot, mask, level) raises that level byte if lower
(slot, state) false in state 0xb or with a bow; otherwise needs a main-hand, two-hand or shield item
footstep effect at the player's position with the boot item's flags and the in-water bit
base projectile ctor 0x150ee4, then vtable 0x50e470, spin 2000 or -2000, kind byte +0x1ce, owner handle +0x1c8
(player, pad) sets record +0x4a64 to -1 or +1 from two buttons (0x41b9f0 / 0x41ba00) when ability button A is up and no cast is running
(player, pad) while blocking (+0x47f): swap button pressed with block held -> state 0xb, movement lock 47 frames
(player, anim) true when one of the active animation tracks plays that animation
(slot, alpha) packed colour per player slot
(slot, skillId) searches the (id, rank) pairs at record +0x4b08; 0 when absent; Player vslot 39 wraps it
(slot, skillId, rank) updates or appends a pair
true when no entry of g_alivePlayers is a local slot; caller is UI
object flag 0x400000 of the first alive local player; caller is the camera
(slot) inventory_removeItem on every bag until empty; Inferred from the loop, caller 0x304c4c
(difficulty, mission) bit 0 of record[0] +0x4bbf + difficulty*13 + mission
(difficulty, mission, on) same bit on the first g_numPlayers records
(difficulty, mission) bit 1 of the same byte
(difficulty, mission, on or -1) bit 1 on all four records
(mission, level) record +0x4c0d + mission on the first g_numPlayers records
(mission, minLevel or -1, flag) reads the medal byte from the LOCAL player's record (net_getLocalPlayerSlot) unless flag is set in a net game, then slot 0
(slot) inverse of player_packRecord: expands the received bytes into the record, then 0x216ea8
(slot or -1) net games only: record +0x4c27 = 60 frames during which Player_takeDamage adds nothing; called by cut_runFrame
(slot, bit) record +0x4c28 bit test; script built-in getPlayerFlag
switch on the first byte of an inventory message: 0 drop, 1 equip, 2 unequip, 4 join panel, 5 set weapon class +0x4a86, 6 stat point, ...; reached through the pointer at 0x3e99c4
s16[4] glow level and s16[4] phase at 0x4d8a38; written only by Player_draw while a healing potion is active
int[4] 0..0x50, hand-light intensity; += 3 * g_playerAuraDir each Player_run; read by Player_draw
int[4][4] r,g,b of the hand lights
float[4] added to g_playerAuraFade each Player_run
float[4] 0..1 strength of the player's coloured light (+0x504)
int[4] +1 while casting, -1 when the cast ends
int[4][4] colour of the light object at player +0x504
int[4] 0..0x80 fade of the interact prompt
int[4] 0/1/2 icon variant of the interact prompt
s8 set to 60 by game message handler 0x18c230; player_recallTick counts it down; non-zero blocks damage and state 0xb
float written by level setup 0x1e55c0; a live player below it takes 1,000,000 damage in Player_run; values <= -90000 disable it
u32[4] pad mask per slot: melee attack / fire
u32[4] pad mask per slot: first ability button
u32[4] pad mask per slot: second ability button
u32[4] pad mask per slot: interact; with raw bit 0x100 also recall
u32[4] pad mask per slot: block
u32[4] pad mask per slot: Player_usePotion kind 0
u32[4] pad mask per slot: Player_usePotion kind 1
